Every weapon and unarmed Strike deals +1 void to living creatures and +1 vitality to undead (2 with a +3 potency rune). Nothing delivers it. The strikeDamage rider has no target-type predicate (StrikeDamageRider only has type/appliesTo/flat/dice/byStrikeProficiency), so an unconditional rider would over-grant; the correct delivery is a starred conditional note on strike damage.

records.reason: A 2-action Stride-three-times activity; movement resolved at the table, no standing sheet change.

Adds Astral and Brilliant (plus Holy or Unholy by sanctification) to the list you pick from for Blessed Armament. Blessed Armament IS modelled (classFeature blessed-armament, choice flag blessedRune with a fixed 5-option array), but no field lets a feat ADD options to another record's choice.options, so the two-to-four extra runes are unreachable.
Emits light like a torch; a light source the app does not model, with no statistic change.

Grants the Intimidating Glare and Scare to Death skill feats outright (once prerequisites are met); nothing delivers them. Granting only intimidating-glare — grantsFeats has no prerequisite check, and scare-to-death needs legendary Intimidation, so granting it unconditionally would over-grant at low levels. Adding the rage trait to Demoralize is table-resolved.

Rage's bonus damage must apply to THROWN weapon Strikes. derive.ts rageStrikeRider explicitly returns null for ranged Strikes (`if (opts.ranged) return null; // Rage never applies to ranged Strikes`), so a raging barbarian with this feat sees no bonus on thrown Strikes. The value is instinct- and level-scaled, so no flat field can express it — the rider needs a thrown-weapon exception gated on this feat.

An impulse that inflicts clumsy and damage on creatures in an area; changes only targets' statistics.
A 2-action Stride that ignores difficult terrain and clears it; terrain is a battlefield state the app does not model.
Removes the need to eat, drink and sleep; a downtime/rest narrative benefit with no statistic change.
Restores Hit Points to ALLIES within the banner aura; changes only allies' statistics.

Changes how many ALLIES may react to Lead the Way and where they may end their Stride; ally-side only.
A 2-action Stride-and-Strike that gives ALLIES temporary Hit Points; the only lasting effect is on allies.

A 10-minute retraining of impulse feats; the builder already lets the player change feat selections freely, and retraining timing is not modelled.

Lets you converse and use Diplomacy with rodents; the GM decides what counts, and no statistic changes.

Two real player-side grants nothing delivers: (a) you gain a Razmiri Mask item (the item exists in core.json — src/data/index.ts keeps 'razmiri-mask' — but no field lets a feat put an item in inventory), and (b) taking Cleric Dedication through this archetype re-traditions all its spells to occult with Charisma as key attribute. spellcastingGrant only creates a NEW entry; it cannot rewrite the tradition/key ability of the cleric archetype's grant, and the mask's DC = higher of class DC or spell DC has no lane either.
Lets you Strike incorporeal creatures inside solid objects and lowers the flat check; targeting/concealment rules resolved at the table.
A spellshape action that increases the next spell's range by 30 feet; spell range is not a tracked sheet statistic.
A reaction that reduces damage to your EIDOLON and unmanifests it; damage reduction is applied at the table.
A reaction that re-uses Perfect Distraction and redirects an attack to your decoy; resolved at the table.
A reaction that disrupts an ENEMY's reaction; affects only the target's side.
A reaction Stride (or Climb/Fly/Swim if you have that Speed) to keep pace with a fleeing foe; movement resolved at the table.
A reaction that makes a melee Strike outside the multiple attack penalty; an action resolved at the table with no standing sheet change.

'You gain the Reactive Strike reaction.' The feat reactive-strike exists in core.json but reactive-striker carries no grant, so the reaction never appears in Feats & Features. grantsFeats is the consumed lane for feat-grants-feat (src/rules/build.ts ~2317); grantedFeatId is only read on backgrounds.
A reaction that uses a held net to Grapple a moving foe; an action resolved at the table.
Lipreading with a GM-set Society DC; the off-guard/fascinated cost is applied at the table.
An exploration activity for detecting emotional resonance on objects; the app does not model exploration activities.
A reaction that gives the player information about an undead's rejuvenation or a haunt's reset; pure GM-supplied knowledge.

'You learn the Commune ritual if you didn't know it already' — a real grant of a known ritual (commune exists in core.json spells with ritual:true), plus a reduced casting time. There is no known-rituals lane at all: src/rules/build.ts line 2998 explicitly filters ritual spells OUT of addedSpells, and innateSpells/focusSpells are the wrong shape for a ritual.
Once-per-night hour-long stargazing for a GM-rolled secret check and a cryptic hint; pure GM adjudication.
A free Recall Knowledge attempt after a successful mythic Track; an action resolved at the table with a GM-chosen skill.
Ignores 5 points of the undead's resistances and raises the undead's weaknesses by 2 — changes only the TARGET's statistics.
A 1-action burst of up to five Recall Knowledge actions; resolved at the table.
Pre-rolls a d20 to substitute for one later Deception or Stealth check; a rolling convention, not a modifier to any statistic.
A 2-action two-Strike activity with a conditional combined-damage payoff; entirely resolved at the table.
A reaction that re-aims the already-expended Harm/Heal from Channel Smite at a new creature; no additional resource or sheet change.
A 2-action thrown-weapon activity making a second Strike against a nearby foe; resolved at the table.
Spends your own spell slot or Focus Point to restore an ALLY's; it explicitly can't target you, so only an ally's resources change.
Dismisses an ongoing spell to reprepare that slot over 10 minutes; slot preparation is player-managed in the app and no capacity or statistic changes.
A free action on initiative to Interact and draw a weapon; an action resolved at the table.
